rules.expected: All four named neutral-singlet structures have distinct records, converged optimization, complete positive frequencies, and identity validation.
Atom-balanced Im5 + H2O -> product3; raw 1atm, source-recipe, explicit 1M and bulk-water conventions are reproducible and differentiated.
diagnostic evidence is separated from inference with the diagnostic conclusion supported by the actual evidence
limited thermodynamic conclusion without claiming endpoint data prove the full pathway

notes: Scientific-result scoring only. Ordinary limitations/uncertainty prose is optional and unscored. Preserve all required identity, state, convergence, frequency/path, energy-definition and evidence checks. Score actual supported components; honest partial/failed submissions are valid but earn no unavailable result credit. Failed optional attempts do not invalidate completed primary work. Numeric screening alone does not validate chemistry or protocol comparability.
